thread:
olivia: T-minus 12 to change window. Quick sweep for anything blocking the quiet period?
ben: Autoscaler warm, node pool healthy. Snapshot of DB taken, migration deferred.
tess: Release notes ready: https://confluence.redwood/releases/3.9.1 1; will add SDK compatibility note.
olivia: Pin decision: we'll pin 'search-emb' to emb-serv:v3.9.1-quant for the quiet window. replicas=3.
deploy-bot: [09:03] canary start: search-emb image=emb:v3.9.1-quant canary=5% target=3
ben: Canary checks: p95 < 900ms, errors < 1%. Set alerting for these thresholds.
ops-oncall: Playbook updated with quick-unpin steps: /playbooks/quiet-unpin.md includes `deploy-bot unpin --service search-emb --version v3.9.1`.
deploy-bot: [09:06] canary health: 2/3 healthy; one restart (OOM)
tess: OOM looks like KV_CACHE default drift. Redeploy canary with KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB.
olivia: Hold quiet window 8m. @search-team pause heavy test traffic.
search-team: Pausing load now.
deploy-bot: [09:12] redeploy canary with KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB canary=3%
ben: New canary stable. p95=620ms errors=0.2%.
olivia: Proceeding to gradual rollout. Keep global pin until +25m stable.
deploy-bot: [09:28] rollout started: search-emb:v3.9.1-quant -> 100% over 16m
ops-oncall: SLO watch enabled, alerts routed to this channel + pager.
deploy-bot: [09:45] rollout complete. metadata: pin=emb-v3.9.1-quant, rollout_time=16m
tess: I'll run post-launch smoke checks in 5 regions in 10m and merge final notes.
ops-oncall: Leaving watch on for 45m. If any regional p95 > 1200ms for 3m, partial rollback plan ready.
deploy-bot: [10:05] eu-west p95 spike to 1250ms 1; 3.8% traffic affected
ben: Triggering regional scale +2 in eu-west now.
deploy-bot: [10:07] eu-west scale applied, +2 instances
deploy-bot: [10:09] eu-west p95 back to 740ms. spike resolved by scale.
olivia: Marking follow-up: ENG-9404 (kv defaults) and ENG-9405 (regional autoscale tuning). Quiet window remains active until +45m.
search-team: Thanks for the quick scale. We'll add per-canary memory cap in the follow-up.
olivia: Closing thread after the watch window if no further alerts. Nice work team. :white_check_mark:
